aboutUs.label: About us
aboutUs.title: Built with Ethiopian
aboutUs.lead: Survai is survey software for CSOs—program teams, M&E staff, and leadership who need evidence they can show a board or donor. One thread from research question to published findings, without retyping tables into slides.
aboutUs.mission: We co-built the first version with Ethiopian civil society groups who ran evaluations across too many apps. They wanted rigor without the admin tax: fewer exports, clearer methods, reports that still match the raw data.
aboutUs.audience: Program leads, M&E staff, researchers, and executives use it when a board or donor will ask “show your work.” Scroll down for the same job done with scattered tools vs. Survai.

challenge.label: Compare
challenge.title: Same goal. Two workflows.
challenge.body: Hover or tap a column—fragmented stack on the left, Survai on the right.
challenge.current1: Plan in a doc, build in a form app, chart in a spreadsheet
challenge.current2: Rewrite the donor narrative by hand every cycle
challenge.current3: Lots of responses, weak line to the next decision
challenge.with1: One pipeline: plan → build → collect → analyze → report
challenge.with2: Report drafts in minutes, every stat traced to responses
challenge.with3: Ask questions of your results before the steering meeting

contrast.title: Stop stitching tools. <hl>Start shipping answers</hl>
contrast.subtitle: Same research goal. Two ways of working. Hover or tap a side to see the difference.

fragmented.label: The old way
fragmented.point1: Plan in docs, build in a form tool, analyze in sheets
fragmented.point2: Weeks writing the donor report by hand
fragmented.point3: Hundreds of responses — still unclear what to do next

survai.label: Survai
survai.point1: Plan, build, collect, analyze, and report in one place
survai.point2: Draft reports in minutes — numbers stay tied to your data
survai.point3: Chat with findings to brief donors, boards, or your team

faq.label: FAQ
faq.headline: Questions teams ask first
faq.lead: Scope, AI, respondents, and rollout—answered directly.

problem.a: Most teams plan in documents, build in a form tool, analyze in spreadsheets, then write the report by hand. Survai connects that whole journey — from research goal to actionable findings — in one place.

numbers.q: Will AI invent numbers in my reports?
numbers.a: No. Counts, percentages, and charts are calculated from your collected responses. AI helps draft and explain the narrative — it does not fabricate statistics.

account.a: No. Share a link or QR code. People answer on a phone or laptop without signing up.

who.a: Program and M&E teams, CSOs and NGOs, researchers, and leaders who need defensible evidence and clear next steps — not another pile of raw responses.

ready.a: Planning, building, reviewing, and collecting are available today. Analysis, reporting, and AI assistance continue to improve with pilot partners.

types.q: What types of surveys does Survai support?
types.a: Training evaluations, needs assessments, beneficiary feedback, baselines, and other program or research surveys.

status.q: What is the current status of the platform?
status.a: Planning, survey building, and data collection are available now. Analysis and reporting are being refined with pilot partners.

languages.a: The product UI supports English and Amharic. Survey content can be authored in the language you choose for each project.
